research_question: At the same training-data budget and success/failure balance, does successful wrist-posture coverage reduce false grasp warnings on new conditions more than additional finger-command noise?
first_diagnostic_question: For the same intended mug grasp, do two feasible wrist settings change the unchanged predictor warning when both actual grasps succeed?

pose_selection.B: The corrected wrist setting stored for this case in the existing zero-noise v3 recording; revalidate under the paired executor.
pose_selection.A: First seek a different geometrically feasible wrist command pair actually observed in the original training partition. If none fits, select a distinct feasible search candidate nearest the original wrist command distribution.
pose_selection.distance: Euclidean distance of the two last wrist commands after scaling with original training mean and scale for command feature indices 48 and 49; no failure scores used.
pose_selection.fallback: Record whether A is within the original command range and whether its training distance is lower than B. Two out-of-range settings test wrist sensitivity, not familiar-versus-unfamiliar inputs.
pose_selection.no_distinct_safe_pair: Mark case no_feasible_pair and retain in inventory; do not force an unsafe wrist or replace the case after inspecting predictions.
pose_selection.pending_implementation: The current executor chooses one wrist setting. Explicit pair selection and versioned execution support are not implemented.
pose_selection.required_before_rollout: Freeze an exact pose manifest containing A/B wrist vectors, carrier compensation, geometry/source hashes, protocol/runtime versions, eligibility and numeric invariance gates. Numerical wrist pairs are not yet available.

held_constant: scene, initial object state, random seed and reset-velocity policy
2 ms physics and 40 ms saved control interval

geometry_and_motion.carrier_compensation: Adjust carrier position/orientation to preserve nominal world palm and intended finger geometry as wrist coordinates change. Do not rotate the intended object grasp.
geometry_and_motion.actual_motion: Measure world palm/finger tracking deviations and physical outcomes. Nominal invariance does not imply identical contact forces or dynamics.

outcome_rule.guard_stop_or_setup_rejection: Null label and unscored; record reason and phase, exclude from task-outcome metrics.

diagnostic_analysis.inventory: Report all eight cases, pair eligibility, actual executions, errors and stops by posture.
diagnostic_analysis.primary: On both-success pairs, compare paired failure scores, success logits and alert decisions. Count B-alert/A-clear and the reverse.
diagnostic_analysis.support: Reconstruct wrist and nonwrist contributions, input training distances, and measured tracking differences.
diagnostic_analysis.interpretation: Both-success alert changes support nuisance-warning sensitivity for the tested paired setups. Outcome-changing pairs are not evidence of harmless pose changes.
diagnostic_analysis.repeatability: Report by proposal and observation family; a repeated direction across at least two proposal families is qualitative repeatability, not a significance or population reliability claim.
diagnostic_analysis.null_result: No alert change does not refute wrist input sensitivity if both poses remain out of range or scores saturate near one. Report logits and limitations.
diagnostic_analysis.not_an_improvement: The model remains unchanged. Score changes alone are not a validated model improvement.

later_data_diversity_test.comparison: Original training base plus an equal-size additional finger-noise cohort versus the same base plus a wrist-coverage cohort.
later_data_diversity_test.controls: Match training episode count, success/failure proportions, base object/proposal identities, model architecture and validation selection rule. Fit normalization on each training set only. If matched cohorts cannot be formed, amend the design before training and do not attribute a confounded difference specifically to wrist versus finger variation.
later_data_diversity_test.evaluation: Declare a common fresh object/posture/observation/proposal holdout before collection; keep it outside training and validation, freeze both models before scoring.
later_data_diversity_test.improvement_rule: At the same 0.5 threshold on that common test set, fewer false warnings among successful grasps without more missed completed failures. Report counts, object/posture breakdowns and paired uncertainty respecting family grouping.
later_data_diversity_test.insufficient_evidence: No failure examples means failure detection is undefined. A few failures cannot establish broad noninferiority. Always warning or never warning fails the joint criterion.
not_allowed: calling the reused eight diagnostic proposals a fresh test
claiming slip onset, useful recovery timing or physical transfer from final task labels

direct_next_steps: Understand this question, comparison and outcome/prediction distinction.
Check geometric feasibility for both wrist settings and implement/audit explicit selection only after this planning step.
Freeze exact A/B pose manifest before any new rollout.
Run one eligible pair first, then all declared eligible development pairs with the frozen model.
Review results before choosing any data augmentation or model change.
